# T012 — Remove stray PowerShell cache and update final report

## Summary

Removed an accidentally checkpointed local PowerShell module-analysis cache without changing application, CI, `.gitignore`, or validation commands. Updated the final report to include this cleanup in the ledger and gate evidence.

## Changes (files and why)

- `Microsoft/Windows/PowerShell/ModuleAnalysisCache`: deleted the exact 22,119-byte binary artifact committed by T011.1 checkpoint `865b926`; explicitly checked each parent directory was empty before removing `Microsoft/Windows/PowerShell`, `Microsoft/Windows`, and `Microsoft`. These directory removals are not tracked changes.
- `.github/modernization/ff4c277d-ed6d-4227-b1d9-ea32d11afff4/final-report.md`: 12 of 23 tasks, T011.1 actual checkpoint and T012 ledger row, current full gates, and persistent audit caveat.
- This note: evidence for the cleanup. No `.gitignore` or source change.

## Decisions (rationale and sources)

- The approved T012 post-checkpoint scope and `git show --name-status 865b926` identify exactly one tracked `Microsoft/` file. The Windows PowerShell platform profile fix prevents this local cache from regenerating; no ignore-rule workaround was applied.
- `git ls-files -- Microsoft` lists the deleted path until the completion checkpoint stages its removal; `git status --porcelain` and `git diff --name-status` show `D` for that exact path. `Test-Path -LiteralPath Microsoft` was false after the build and tests. No other tracked changes appeared before report/note edits.

## Validation (commands and results)

- After deleting the cache, exact build `msbuild -restore -p:RestorePackagesConfig=true -p:Configuration=Release -m -nologo -v:minimal`: exit 0, all four projects built; two existing NU1902 warnings, MSB3247 and CS0168 in unchanged legacy code. A subsequent incremental run after report/note edits exited 0 with only the two NU1902 and MSB3247 warning lines.
- Then exact tests `dotnet test --no-build -c Release`: exit 0; net48 23 passed, net10 56 passed; **79 passed, 0 failed, 0 skipped**. No lint defined.
- After both initial gates, `git status --porcelain` and `git diff --name-status` reported only the cache deletion (before report/note edits); `git ls-files -- Microsoft` reported its historical tracked path, and no `Microsoft/` directory existed on disk. Recheck after the final full validation.

## Follow-ups and risks

- The T011.1 dependency scan remains **incomplete** (solution-level `dotnet list package` failure and unaudited 32-entry legacy `packages.config`); the two moderate jQuery advisories remain open. Cache cleanup does not remediate dependencies.
- Completion checkpoint is pending; verify again that full gates did not recreate the cache. If it reappears, stop rather than adding `.gitignore` or changing the PowerShell profile in this task.
